'''Axkatta''' was an individual who served the [[Hutt Empire]] during the time of the [[Xim Wars]], as the chief financial planner of [[Clan-General]] [[Kossak Inijic Ar'durv]]. During the conflict, Axkatta was sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]] and wandered the [[Derelkoos Desert]], trying to rally the local population, so that they could be recruited by the Empire, in preparation for the [[Third Battle of Vontor]].
